subject: MAP & evaluation milestones — audit logs add-on pricing and commit-linked discounts
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Joe Duncan <joe.duncan@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed MAP & evaluation plan for Redwood pilot (audit logs ask)

Joe —

Thanks again for taking the demo last week. Per our conversation, I’m attaching an initial mutual action plan (MAP) that ties evaluation milestones to commercial milestones so we can align legal/procurement expectations up front. The attached sheet (RDW_MAP_Acme_v2.xlsx) lays out:

- Week 0–2: Proof-of-concept / connectivity + security review (data flows, network allowlists)
- Week 2–4: Evaluation tests (latency/cost e2e, quality checks on 3 prompt sets)
- Week 4–6: Pilot ramp (10k tokens/day -> 100k tokens/day) and final security sign-off

Two items you flagged that I wanted to call out: audit logs / retention and premium controls for admin roles. We can include a compliance add-on in the pilot so your security team can evaluate retention/export capabilities without waiting for enterprise procurement.

High-level commercial approach I’m proposing:
- Baseline pilot pricing: Hosted evaluation rate of $0.0022 per token (metered).
- Compliance add-on (audit logs + 12mo retention + export): $2,500/month for the pilot period. Includes CSV exports of logs and SSO-admin controls.
- Ramp/commit discount: If you sign a 12-month committed usage agreement at or above 2M tokens/mo within 30 days of pilot completion, we’ll apply a 12% discount to hosted rates and waive the first 2 months of the compliance add-on.

I’ve included an example DocuSign link for the provisional MAP acknowledgement (non-binding) so procurement can see proposed milestones without a full SOW.

Can you loop in your security lead for a short sync? Happy to walk through the audit logs capabilities and share the Audit-Addons_Pricing_v1.pdf.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: RDW_MAP_Acme_v2.xlsx, Audit-Addons_Pricing_v1.pdf
From: Joe Duncan <joe.duncan@acme-corp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme Security Team <security@acme-corp.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed MAP & evaluation plan for Redwood pilot (audit logs ask)

Marissa —

Thanks for this. Quick notes from security/procurement:

- Security: We need event-level audit logs with immutable timestamps and a retention option up to 24 months for regulated workflows. CSV export is fine for eval, but we’ll need an API export and HMAC verification if we move to production. Also request: bring-your-own-key (BYOK) for logs encryption on the enterprise plan.

- Procurement: Pilot pricing looks ok but we need clearer escalation path for pricing if we exceed the 100k tokens/day ramp during the pilot. Also want to avoid vendor lock for the audit exports — we’ll include a clause requiring a 30-day export window post-termination.

We can join a security sync Thurs at 10:00 PT. Also can you confirm the rollback/fallback plan if the model quality regressions show during evaluation?

Joe Duncan
Head of AI Integrations, Acme Financials
joe.duncan@acme-corp.com | +1 (312) 555-0912

Cc: Acme Security Team <security@acme-corp.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed MAP & evaluation plan for Redwood pilot (audit logs ask)

Joe —

Appreciate the clarity — below are concrete adjustments we can accept for the pilot and proposed commercial guardrails tied to MAP milestones. I’ve also attached a one-page pricing summary (Audit-Addons_Pricing_v1.pdf).

Security / controls commitments for the pilot (non-production):
- Audit exports: CSV + API export endpoint. Exports include event_type, user_id (hashed), timestamp (RFC3339), request_payload_size, model_id.
- Retention: Pilot default 12 months, with option to extend to 24 months for a one-time trial fee of $1,500 for the pilot period (covers storage + export tooling).
- BYOK: Available on Private deployment only; for hosted pilot we’ll provide encrypted logs with customer-controlled KMS customer-managed keys as part of Dedicated/Private conversations.
- HMAC verification: Available as an add-on on enterprise contracts (post-pilot).

Commercial MAP-linked terms (proposal):
- Milestone A (Connectivity & Security review complete): no charge beyond baseline eval rate.
- Milestone B (Quality gates met on 3 prompt sets and throughput tests): trigger a pilot completion credit of $5,000 applied to first invoice if you execute a 12mo commit within 30 days.
- Milestone C (Pilot Ramp to 100k tokens/day sustained for 7 days): trigger discounted committed rates — 12% off hosted list for the first 12 months of commitment and waived compliance add-on for first 60 days.

Compliance add-on pricing (pilot):
- Audit Logs (API + CSV export) + 12mo retention + admin controls: $2,500/month
- 24mo retention option (pilot): one-time $1,500 trial fee
- HMAC verification & long-term export tooling (enterprise): priced separately — indicative: $8,000 setup + $1,000/mo

Rollback / fallback plan: during the evaluation we’ll maintain a model-variant fallback that preserves last-known-good weights and an automatic traffic split to fallback variant if error rate (as defined by your QA tests) exceeds 5% for 1 hour. That reduces risk for production.

Next steps:
1) Security sync Thurs 10:00 PT (I’ll send calendar invite).
2) Execute non-binding MAP acknowledgement via DocuSign so procurement can review milestones while we run the pilot.
3) If MAP milestones are met, procurement and I will convert this to a SOW with committed terms and schedule in pricing adjustments.

If this looks good I’ll loop in Legal to get a pilot-friendly addendum written (short form) that includes export/termination window language.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Acme MAP pricing approval request (RDW-5238)

Rishi / Lauren —

Quick internal note following the security sync and Joe’s feedback. Summary: Acme wants 24mo retention option, API export, and clarity on BYOK. They also want a guardrail against price escalation during pilot ramp.

Recommend we approve the pilot commercial concessions below so sales can close within the quarter:
- Approve pilot compliance add-on pricing as proposed: $2,500/mo with optional 24mo retention trial fee $1,500.
- Offer the ramp/commit discount: 12% off hosted rates for 12 months if customer signs 12mo commit >= 2M tokens/mo within 30 days of pilot completion. Waive first 60 days of compliance add-on on commit.
- Approve the non-binding MAP acknowledgement (DocuSign) to be shared with Acme procurement immediately.

Risks: slight downside to short-term revenue if they ramp aggressively during pilot and require extended retention — but we mitigate with one-time extension fee and by pushing BYOK to Dedicated/Private.

If you approve, I’ll ask Legal to draft the pilot addendum and I’ll share the DocuSign link with Joe.

Thanks —
Marissa
